# KR8TIV full machine manifest

> Map of kr8tiv.io for answer engines. The linked pages are the source of truth. This file does not reprint article bodies.

Last updated: 16 November 2026. Prices are Canadian dollars (CAD), starting points only, with final scope agreed in writing before work begins. No GST charged.

## Two offers, one founder

KR8TIV (https://kr8tiv.io) is the Edmonton studio. Matt Haynes works with about ten clients a year on websites, brands, signs, packaging, motion, and marketing. Full websites start from $1,200 CAD. Landing pages start from $850 CAD.

KR8TIV AI (https://kr8tiv.ai) is the sister lab. Business AI systems, company brains, agents, and product apps belong there. Same founder. Different offer.

Shown on Google as "Kr8tiv". No public street address and no walk-in studio. Meetings are by call or by appointment.

## Service area

Edmonton, Sherwood Park, St. Albert, Spruce Grove, Alberta, and clients across Canada. Remote projects further afield.

## Field notes

Each line is a title, one sentence, and the URL. Read the page for the full answer.

- How AI can make a small business more creative. Use it for a pile of options, then score the options against the real shop, the real offer, and a phone in the dark. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/ai-creativity-small-business-edmonton/

- Template or custom website? A custom site pays off when it fixes a specific enquiry problem the current site cannot. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/template-vs-custom-website/
- Logo or brand? A logo is the mark. A brand is the system a customer meets on the site, the sign, and the sales conversation. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/logo-vs-brand-small-business/
- Evolve Eco Blasting. KR8TIV's published figures for the first four months are CAD $1.4 million in enquiries and CAD $450,000 in sales. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/evolve-eco-blasting-case-study/
- When a custom website pays off in Alberta. Start from the business problem, and treat the CAD $600 example on the page as fictional, not a KR8TIV result. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/website-that-earns-its-keep-alberta/
- Storefront sign design in Edmonton. A sign concept is design only, and the physical build is a fabricator's job. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/storefront-sign-design-edmonton/
- A blog that brings leads. Write pages that answer a real buying question, then give the reader one clear way to call. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/blog-that-ranks-and-brings-leads/
- Local advertising in Edmonton. Spend follows a clear offer and a page that can take the enquiry. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/local-advertising-edmonton-alberta/
- A marketing campaign in Edmonton. Name the customer, the offer, and the next step before buying media. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/marketing-campaign-edmonton/
- Signage designed with AI. Use AI for options, then check the sign against the real storefront and the permit. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/ai-signage-design-edmonton/
- Storefront layout designed with AI. A render is not a layout until the path, the sign, and the door still work on site. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/ai-storefront-layout-design-edmonton/
- Vehicle wraps designed with AI. The file has to match the actual vehicle, not only the mockup. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/ai-vehicle-wrap-design-edmonton/
- Packaging that still works when printed. The standout mark has to survive the dieline, the stock, and the shelf. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/packaging-design-that-stands-out-canada/
- Signage that attracts customers. The sign has to be readable by the person who is actually walking or driving past. https://kr8tiv.io/blog/signage-that-attracts-customers-edmonton/
